the pass starts from an unlinked login
the cookie notice is answered like a person would
an unlinked login is told so, in the page, not in an empty day
every practitioner record is offered as a claim

and names whose day it is

an owner can read a colleague’s day, and it says so
the day reads on a desk screen too
